name: ai-note-taking-app
audience_feeling: A student should feel that a missed sentence is not a lost lecture, and that the notes they end up with are their own to study from.
promise: Lecture audio becomes structured study notes a student can read, search, and revise from.

preferred_terms.notes: the structured study material produced from a lecture
preferred_terms.transcript: the raw timestamped text of the audio

avoid: invented metrics (accuracy percentages, time saved, cost per student)
claiming shipped features while the repository has no implementation
describing a competitor's internal implementation as fact
unexplained acronyms (DSA, ADA, STT, diarization) on first use
speaking on behalf of a university's accessibility policy
